title: Spread by seniority: interquartile range and median

coverage.note: Debt-like positions only (21,891 rows); of those 19,009 carry a parsed spread_bps. Quantiles are fair-value weighted. Equity and preferred positions are excluded by construction, which is why they do not appear as missing spreads here.
coverage.sentence: Computed on 19,009 of 31,067 investment-panel rows (61.2% of the window panel). Debt-like positions only (21,891 rows); of those 19,009 carry a parsed spread_bps. Quantiles are fair-value weighted. Equity and preferred positions are excluded by construction, which is why they do not appear as missing spreads here.

source: Source: author's calculations on the ARCC BDC panel built from SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q filings.
